summary: Iteration 11 full-stack test of CLIENTS + per-client datasheet library. Backend: 13/13 pytest cases pass (clients CRUD incl. case-insensitive dedupe, archive/restore, re-activate-on-POST, auth gate 401, client detail 14 products/12 docs, client datasheet upload+delete with catalogue rebuild, apply-client-library idempotency 3x = 14 with zero duplicate persisted rows, client isolation, pack.html appendix + pack.pdf). Frontend: /clients list + add/archive/restore, row -> /clients/:id detail (4 catalog groups ASHP/LOFT/SOLAR/VENT, 12 datasheets, Upload control), /import Step 1 'Who is this design for?' with pills + add-new, Generate Draft Design correctly disabled until client AND >=1 doc, old per-project datasheet dropzone confirmed GONE and replaced by client-library note reflecting Coldrush's 14 products, Workspace Evidence 'Apply client library' toasts 'Applied 14 product(s) from the client library' and ASHP measure shows exactly 4 Mitsubishi rows (no duplication). No regressions found.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is 3132 lines — well over the 700-line guideline; clients/datasheet-library, pack rendering and project CRUD should be split into routers/modules.

_apply_client_catalog() returns early when the client has no products, so it never strips previously applied source='catalog' rows. If a client's library is emptied (all datasheets deleted), re-running apply-client-library on their projects leaves stale catalog products in measures. Recommend calling _assign_products(project, [], source='catalog') in the no-products branch.

Client resolution is by name regex (project.client string) rather than by client_id on the project. Renaming a client via PATCH /api/clients/{id} silently orphans its projects from the library. Consider storing client_id on projects.
delete_client_datasheet() returns 200 even when doc_id/client_id do not match anything (update_one matched_count unchecked) — should 404 on no match.
seed_data_creation: Created and then archived throwaway clients: 'TEST_QA Client Iter11', 'TEST_QA Upload Client', 'TEST_UI Client A'. Coldrush verified untouched at 12 documents / 14 products; no reseed needed.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Regression suites: test_iter11_clients.py (fast) and test_iter11_upload.py (uploads to a throwaway TEST_ client so Coldrush stays at 12 docs/14 products). Idempotency regression from iteration_10 is FIXED and covered. Note RTF-2026-0140 legitimately has 2 LOFT products with source=None (pre-existing/manual) — assert on source=='catalog' rows only when testing isolation, not on manufacturer names. Three archived TEST_ clients remain in the DB (visible in /clients Archived section).
rca_of_the_issue: Iteration-10 duplicate accumulation is resolved: _assign_products() now strips prior rows matching the same source before re-adding, plus normalised manufacturer|product dedupe. Verified 3 consecutive applies keep exactly 14 unique catalog rows persisted in measures[*].products.
